admission.gate: Even all QC stages passing only produces a component-QC candidate. A separate source/rights/deidentification/overlap/task-purpose admission record is required before training; native scanner, clinical, glioma, planning and surgical claims remain unsupported.

bounds.overflow: Stop affected pair, retain failure; do not silently increase caps or drop difficult subjects. Campaign deadline leaves explicit not_attempted rows. Visual review pending never becomes pass by timeout.
bounds.retention: One pair staged/decoded at a time; source gzip copies plus receipts/views <=8 GiB campaign cap, no retained full uncompressed cohort arrays. Existing immutable archive is outside the incremental cap but included in free-disk preflight.
bounds.rss_limit_note: RSS watchdog is an operational stop, not an OS-enforced instantaneous ceiling; reject allocations from header budgets first.

execution_preconditions: Root binds the future QC scope and declaration to this proposal, frozen sources, exact pair worklist, reviewed implementation and environment. This preparation does not authorize extraction.
Build a narrow SynthRAD driver without changing acquisition or other-dataset drivers. Verify allowlist, source joins, role guards, archive stat continuity and central-directory evidence.

Do not redundantly rehash the 14.47 GB archive. Use existing verification receipt plus unchanged inode/device/size/mtime/ctime and directory binding; any continuity change stops the queue for an explicit fixity review.

Freeze offline controls for malicious ZIP paths/duplicates/local-central disagreement, CRC/truncation, compressed expansion/header allocation bounds, inactive versus active qforms, units/singular affine, intensity failures, split protection, timeout/interruption and no-admission invariants before real member access.

No network, registration fit, resampling repair, segmentation, weights, optimizer, or model outputs in QC. Display mapping may use the validated affine and must be recorded without saving transformed scientific inputs.

invariants: Every frozen TRAIN subject appears exactly once in final denominator accounting, including first-pair reuse.
Keep partial outputs and failed attempt lineage; no overwrite, silent retry, replacement subject or excluding failures from rates.
Failure in one validly accounted subject does not convert other subjects to failures; source-binding, split, systemic parser, privacy-release or resource-control defects stop the relevant queue.
Recompute summary counts from pair receipts; every pass requires referenced artifacts and parent completion. Missing receipt is incomplete, never a pass.
required_receipt: attempt ID and declared intent before work
elapsed time, peak RSS and bytes

first_pair.completion_gate: All mechanical checks, source-native QC views, and explicit registration/coverage/deidentification dispositions must exist. Header success alone cannot start anatomy-dependent use.
first_pair.limit: exactly ct.nii.gz and mr.nii.gz for this subject, one attempt; no mask, spreadsheet, overview, pelvis, protected role, or other subject access
first_pair.then: Freeze full TRAIN execution declaration and evidence fields; reuse first pair receipt if unchanged, then process remaining 125 once in declared order. If first pair exposes code/schema defects, stop expansion; if validly measured anatomical exclusion, retain failure and require fixed disposition rules before continuation.
first_pair.why: rank 1 center A under the frozen metadata-only order

checks: Open only selected ZipInfo after unique safe nonencrypted regular member and exact name/offset/size checks; never extractall or testzip.
Stream at most 1 MiB per read into a new staging file, enforce advertised gzip-member size and selected-member limit, read to EOF for ZIP CRC, measure SHA256 of each extracted original member.
Cross-check local header with directory, preserve original NIfTI gzip bytes; use no-overwrite publication, record archive receipt hash, role manifest hash, directory row and extracted SHA256.

Bound gzip prefix before allocations: exact supported NIfTI-1 single-file magic, header length, positive 3D scalar shape, real integer/float dtype and bitpix, integer bounded data offset, extension framing, finite effective scaling.
Record raw header hash and protected raw bytes plus v2 coded-transform record; qform_code 0 remains inactive, never invent a quaternion frame or reject solely its unused encoding.
Stream all source scalars within limits; validate complete gzip/CRC, exact payload length, no unexpected trailing decompressed bytes, all effective values finite and nonconstant.

Record unscaled/effective datatype, slope/intercept, units, extrema, percentiles and clipping/background fractions; suspicious range is a review flag. MR scale is arbitrary; do not invent HU or require universal CT/MR ranges.

Clinical CT scaling and bone contrast remain pending until source protocol/scaling evidence and anatomy review agree; any future threshold-derived bone is an algorithmic derivative, not manual ground truth.
Require explicit mm/meter/micron units converted explicitly to mm and at least one valid active coded transform; no default scanner frame.

If both qform and sform active, maximum world-space corner discrepancy <=0.01 mm; require finite invertible affine with abs determinant >=1e-12, last row [0,0,0,1], no shear by direction Gram tolerance 1e-4.
Affine spacing must match header spacing within atol 0.01 mm and rtol 1e-4. Record shape, orientation, handedness, obliquity, world bounds, voxel volume and field of view.

Record CT/MR shapes and maximum corresponding-corner difference. Equal shape and <=0.01 mm correspondence qualifies only source coded-grid correspondence. Different grids remain grid_review_pending; do not auto-align or silently copy affines.
No header result establishes anatomical registration, true patient identity, or original scanner/surgical frame.

After privacy gate, render reproducible source-native axial/coronal/sagittal views at predeclared fractional levels, with physical coordinates, orientation labels and recorded display windows; inspect entire extent via bounded slice contact sheets for coverage.

Review paired views/checkerboard or opacity overlays only on proven common grid. Record brain anatomy, gross correspondence at intracranial/skull landmarks, left/right consistency, coverage of vertex and skull base, and motion/metal/truncation/defacing artifacts.
Make separate pass/fail/review_pending decisions for gross registration, intracranial coverage, and calvarium usability; localize defects by source voxel/world coordinate and saved panel hash.

Same affine and visual plausibility alone do not establish registration accuracy. Any quantitative landmark claim needs an explicitly defined landmark protocol and source-bound annotations; no ad hoc tuned acceptance threshold.

Outline mask remains unextracted and is not skull/brain/tumor/vessel truth. Do not infer glioma, preoperative status, tumor target, access trajectory, functional anatomy, operative observations or clinical accuracy.

identities.binding: frozen cohort exact subject_id, patient_group, source_family, anonymous_center, role, and exact member name
identities.selection_order: ascending rank_within_center, anonymous_center, subject_id; determined without image data
identities.source_challenge_role: all released training; distinct from project role
identities.source_conflict: Provider prose states no center B brain MR; its table, frozen preview, and actual directory list 60 brain CT/MR pairs per center. Preserve conflict; do not assign centers to named institutions.

leakage.cross_role: Directory size+CRC comparison found no candidates but cannot establish uniqueness. Do not decode protected roles to solve this during TRAIN QC; use separately authorized blinded provenance/hash audit when available.
leakage.decision: QC may proceed on frozen TRAIN pairs while overlap is unresolved, but passing QC alone does not clear the unresolved admission gate.
leakage.external: Task2, later SynthRAD releases and same-institution datasets have unresolved person overlap. Require crosswalk or documented exclusion of ambiguous families before joint training/measurement admission. No independent external-validation or institution-holdout claim.
leakage.protected_roles: SELECT and MEASUREMENT_EVAL receive directory identity accounting only; no payload, visual review, normalization fitting or tuning in this execution.
leakage.within_train: Compare measured gzip member SHA256 and optional source-value digests with approved source-index hashes; exact duplicate hits trigger identity investigation before admission.

rights_and_deidentification.basis: frozen metadata and license proofs; no new legal interpretation
future_gate: Check exact allowed pseudonymous paths and ZIP/gzip filenames/comments; never infer personal identities.
Boundedly inspect NIfTI descrip, aux_file, intent_name and extension content for identifiers; helper extension framing alone does not clear privacy.
Keep any suspect raw strings/extension payloads restricted locally; publish only redacted flags, hashes and disposition. Unknown or opaque private extensions remain review_pending.
Visually review rendered source slices for residual identifying text/face features and document defacing/crop effects on calvarium. Do not reconstruct faces or reidentify people.
Any unresolved personal identifier finding quarantines that pair from portable views and admission; preserve original archive unchanged.
rights_and_deidentification.provider_claim: Brain face removal/anonymization is reported; local metadata or voxel deidentification has not been checked.
rights_and_deidentification.scope: noncommercial research component only; attribution with DOI/version/creators, license link and derivative changes retained; no commercial admission

source.provenance_definition: Released acquired CT and MRI after provider conversion, rigid registration, defacing and cropping; not original scanner DICOM or established native geometry.

utility_review.use: nifti1_header_record_coded_v2 preserves inactive qform encoding correctly; explicitly bind recorder version.
inspect_nifti and corner displacement implement explicit units/active-form/affine checks; do not invoke load_nifti_case as a QC shortcut because it decodes and creates a case.

scalar_budget and inspect_original offer bounded scalar/framing review; use explicit v2 recorder and reviewed SynthRAD wrapper, not Lausanne CLI. Current extrema-only scan and framed extensions do not supply deidentification, nonconstant, percentiles or anatomy review.
Patterns for header receipt replay, pair grid comparison, source snapshots and failure-preserving supervision; RESECT pair driver/worklist cannot be repurposed unchanged for CT/MR.
inspect_extensions validates framing only; opaque payloads are not privacy-cleared.
atomic_preserve, deadlines, worker supervision and termination cleanup are reusable primitives. Do not call verify_source_file on the entire archive in this phase.
